unit: One search in Chrome with the assigned source excerpt. Record initially rendered candidate positions and status. Count controls separately from answerable questions; do not silently discard empty result sets.

flags.candidateExposure: At least one original row is shown as a possible passage, regardless of caution.
flags.explicitCaution: The default result text explicitly says the proposed evidence is insufficient to confirm the claim, signals a pending or held decision, or calls for additional original evidence due to the insufficiency. A generic statement of matching words or search tips alone does not satisfy this criterion. Record the actual text.
flags.observedHumanAbstention: Not measured. Even a clear caution is not an observed editor decision.

breakdown: Report counts with denominators for the four unanswered controls and ten answerable questions (for answerable controls report caution exposure only, not false editorial decisions). A cautious result with candidates is distinct from a return of zero candidates.
